doc: Allocates a 0x2000-byte scratch buffer via func_80040574(0x2000), zeroes it with bzero, then based on the s16 flag parameter a0, LoadImage()s one of two RECT/TIM headers (D_800710DC if a0!=0, else D_800710D4) into the buffer, DMAs/draws it out via two separate func_8003F80C calls (offset 0x7A40/0x7A41 then 0x79C0/0x79C1, both with a2=1,a3=2), and finally calls DrawSync(0). The two branches each contain their own full pair of func_8003F80C calls (not a shared post-if call) -- gcc's cross-jump/tail-merge only fuses the identical suffix (a2=1;jal;a3=2) of the second call in each branch, leaving the differing a1 immediate (0x79C0 vs 0x79C1) and the (identical but unmerged) a0=buf setup duplicated in each arm.

globals.name: D_800710D4
globals.decl: struct { s16 x, y, w, h; s32 pad; } D_800710D4; /* real data is a RECT (8B); pad forces hi/lo addressing over $gp */

globals.name: D_800710DC
globals.decl: struct { s16 x, y, w, h; s32 pad; } D_800710DC; /* real data is a RECT (8B); pad forces hi/lo addressing over $gp; immediately follows D_800710D4 by 8 bytes in retail, i.e. likely element [1] of a RECT[2] array, but kept as a separate symbol since splat already emits it separately */

calls: func_80040574(s32 a0) -> void* : bump/ring allocator, called with 0x2000 (size), returns scratch buffer pointer
bzero(void *ptr, s32 len) -- library, called with (buf, 0x2000)
LoadImage(RECT *rect, void *p) -- real BIOS func @0x800672d8, takes address of a RECT/TIM header struct and a VRAM/RAM buffer pointer
func_8003F80C(s32 a0, s32 a1, s32 a2, s32 a3) -- called 4 times total (2 per branch): (buf, 0x7A40/0x7A41, 1, 2) then (buf, 0x79C0/0x79C1, 1, 2)
